The questions clubs ask.
Do we have to replace our existing data providers?
No. Marquee sits on top of the stack you already trust: your event data, tracking, video, scouting providers, and internal reports. You keep what works. You just stop paying the tax of having it scattered across twelve tools.
Marquee also works without any of it. The platform reads event, physical, off-the-ball and financial data on its own, so a club that connects nothing still gets scored shortlists, 360 reports and market alerts from day one. Connecting your own stack and your internal knowledge enriches every output and tunes it further to your context.
Who owns our data?
You do. Your data stays yours, and it is never used to train models for anyone else. What your club knows stays your competitive edge.
How is our data secured?
Every club is an isolated tenant with encrypted storage, so nothing crosses between clubs. Marquee is SOC 2 compliant.View all
